comparisons.reason: Feature 0 is 1 if any comment relies on an abstract normative principle. Feature 1 requires all substantive comments to be solely abstract normative, with no labor details, and returns null for an empty list. Any versus all, with different exclusions.

Feature 0 covers only moral or normative principles (fairness, rights, justice). Feature 2 also counts definitions, general logic and theoretical reasoning. The two also differ on an empty list: Feature 0 gives null or 0 by its own wording, while Feature 2 gives 0 for an empty list. Feature 0 also requires no specific institutional anchoring, while Feature 2 counts a comment if the principle is a main basis even when a concrete example is present.

Feature 1 requires all substantive comments to be solely abstract normative, with no concrete labor details, and gives null on an empty list. Feature 2 requires at least one comment with an abstract principle and gives 0 on an empty list.
